issue.description:
ADR-005 is Accepted with no corresponding implementation bead and, unlike ADR-003, no activation annotation. Add a `ready_frontier` check under doctor's dependencies scope that warns when open issues carry an assignee (held off the ready frontier), names a bounded sample of offending ids, and states the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). Advisory only: doctor must never clear an assignee, not even under --repair — lock both the warning and the refusal with tests, plus the empty-sample and bounded-sample cases. If the check already exists in the doctor implementation, convert this into a verification bead recording the passing evidence.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement (or verify shipped) the doctor ready_frontier assignment-hold check (ADR-005)

issue.description:
AGENTS.md defines NEEDLE compatibility by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md and forbids claiming compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite, while the tool is already the fleet-canonical `bead` binary. The only visible NEEDLE-facing coverage is the one-off claim-epoch consumer canary (BR-T27), which is narrower than the contract. Derive executable conformance cases from the contract's command, output, and exit-code surface (claim and the ready frontier, lifecycle mutations, list/show projections, sync/checkpoint interchange), run them as a persistent lane in bead-rs-ci on every release-gate run, and make a contract version change without a matching suite update a CI failure so compatibility stays verified rather than asserted.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Build the standing NEEDLE CLI contract v1 conformance suite and wire it into release gates

issue.description: Implement the explicit reviewed-resolution transition for a durable recovery quarantine after audited redaction or an equivalent reviewed resolution. Acceptance criteria: the transition rechecks live and retained generations under the publication lock, stores only value-free evidence, clears the hold exactly once, preserves rollback on failure, and permits the intended publication without silently weakening scanner policy; replay is idempotent and diagnostics remain redacted; targeted concurrency and redaction tests plus required verification pass, with evidence recorded on this child.
issue.notes: Implemented audited quarantine-resolution hardening in commit deeb99f0: retained live pointers and legacy retained input are re-scanned under the existing publication lock before both preflight and transactional publication; malformed or unreadable retained coverage fails closed with value-free diagnostics; the existing enabled audited redaction/sanitized-republish path clears the hold atomically, preserves rollback, and replay remains one-reset-event/idempotent. Added redaction, malformed-retained-pointer, and replay assertions. Verification on committed archive passed: scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast (fmt plus full cargo test), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and targeted cargo tests for checkpoint_publication_lock, quarantine_git_publication, redaction_publication, and secret_gap_contract, all exit 0. git push exit 0; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD empty. Pre-staging status confirmed only the three implementation/test paths belonged to this bead; unrelated work was not staged.
issue.title: Implement audited resolution for quarantined publication
